EVIDENCE & LIMITS

What we tested. Where it fails.

Project brief ↓

644 synthetic development traces, each 180 seconds. These are regression probes, not clinical validation or held-out accuracy estimates.

Selected synthetic evaluation cohorts · policy vg-demo-1.1
Test conditionDetected anomaliesFalse reviewsObserved behavior
Noise & baseline offsets100 / 1000 / 100Median detection delay: 40 seconds
Continuous stream loss0 / 400 / 40NO DATA from second 48; underlying anomaly missed
Misleading oxygen + activity0 / 400 / 40Silent miss: MONITORING with a high evidence index

Human review cannot protect an anomaly that never reaches review. The evidence index measures available input quality, not the probability that a person is safe.

Read the evaluation scope

Median/MAD learns a resting baseline within each session. Fixed rules govern escalation. The activity-veto rule was revised using these development cohorts. There are no patient recordings, authenticated reviewers, clinical predictions, external alerts, or persistent sessions. Pausing playback freezes simulated time; it does not simulate a stream outage.

Session exports include SHA-256 integrity checks. The digest is not a digital signature or protection against someone replacing both the payload and digest.
